messages.text: Your refund proposal is for **BRL 99.90**. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a “yes” in chat won’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

I need the refund to go back to my original payment method, not just be recorded in a test ledger. Can you arrange that?
